headline: Nigeria Broad Money Supply Rises to N147tn in September
summary: Nigeria’s broad money supply (M3) increased by N7.51tn to N146.6tn in September following recent interest rate cuts by the Central Bank of Nigeria.
why: Broad money supply tracks total liquidity within an economy, influencing domestic credit growth, inflation trends, and commercial bank lending capacity.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Expansion in the money supply following rate cuts increases domestic liquidity, which can stimulate economic activity or feed inflationary pressures.
